Blair's Highest Truthful ATS Resume Scores

Expanded role targets ranked by estimated resume-keyword alignment (application range) using index.html facts — L3 managed hosting, Linux/RHCE, MySQL/Percona, WordPress/WooCommerce/Magento, AWS/OpenStack, technical sales/solutions, plus clearly grouped enterprise / SMB management, luxury / brand operations, stock / inventory, and product / digital management tracks.

Source refresh: Parsed from the uploaded current index.html on October 22, 2026. Application-title coverage is limited to roles scoring 80% or higher; percentages are illustrative alignment estimates, not verified employer ATS results. Technical roles with direct source evidence are the strongest fit; manager, luxury, stock, and product roles are conditional where formal team/budget ownership, luxury-sector tenure, forecasting, or product-roadmap authority is not explicitly documented.

Highest fact-supported modeled ATS alignment by job title (October 22, 2026 index.html). Current evidence fit → highest modeled ATS alignment from a fully tailored, factual resume. Each title is scored for the strongest factually rewritten, job-specific resume supported by index.html. 100% identifies a role-title checklist fully supported by documented portfolio facts; scores below 80% have been excluded from the displayed dataset; it is NOT a perfect match to a specific job posting or a measured employer ATS result. Other roles retain conservative qualification penalties. This is a modeled ATS alignment estimate, not a measured result from an employer ATS. Tailoring may improve wording and selection of genuine experience but cannot create missing certifications, leadership responsibilities, or production experience. Historical scores remain stored in each record for comparison.
